adopt: Point it at one transcript directory and read back what those sessions learned, with the line each lesson came from.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Every agent session leaves a transcript, and almost every transcript is thrown away. The correction a human made at turn 40, the retry that finally worked, the six-command sequence three sessions each re-derived -- all of it sits in JSONL nobody reads, while the next session starts from zero.

Install
pip install git+https://github.com/Aitherium/awmine.git

Commands
  awmine

Quick start
  pip install awmine
synopsis: Mine what your agents did -- outcomes, lessons and procedures out of the transcripts they left behind.
